findings.title: Filtered Grafana rules render without a list key
findings.body: FilterViewResults maps filtered rules into a list and previously passed key={key} to GrafanaRuleLoader. The replacement GrafanaRuleListItem is rendered with no key, even though getRuleKey still builds one. React will reuse the wrong row when pages append or the filter result set shifts, so action menus, drawers, and focus can attach to a different rule than the one the user clicked.

findings.title: Pause is never offered in the ruler-less list
findings.body: The list view now computes canPause from Grafana Prometheus abilities because ruler rules are no longer loaded, but the Pause item is still gated on rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule). GrafanaRuleListItem only passes promRule, so rulerRule is undefined and Pause stays hidden for every Grafana-managed rule even when the user is allowed to pause it.

findings.title: Delete stays hidden without a ruler rule
findings.body: canDelete is OR-ed with the new Prometheus ability so list-view permissions can allow deletion, but the Delete menu item is still rendered only when rulerRule is truthy. The new list never supplies a ruler rule, so users with delete permission cannot delete a Grafana rule from the list. The group-loader menu test also encodes this by expecting four items and omitting Delete despite granting AlertingRuleDelete.

findings.title: Silence menu item opens nothing
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu can show Silence from Prometheus-rule abilities and calls handleSilence, which only sets showSilenceDrawer. The drawer is still mounted only when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true. In the list view rule is undefined, so clicking Silence notifications does not open SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer and the action is a no-op.

findings.title: Federated rules are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities used to set isFederated from isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) before deciding edit, delete, pause, and duplicate support. The refactor hardcodes isFederated to false and forwards every combined rule through useAllRulerRuleAbilities. Federated cloud rule groups, which this helper still serves outside the list view, can now be edited or deleted even though federation makes them immutable.

findings.title: Rule view links drop the return path
findings.body: The removed list item built the view href with createReturnTo() so leaving a filtered or grouped list could navigate back to that list. The new href is only /alerting/grafana/${uid}/view. Opening a rule from the list no longer preserves the list URL, so the rule view's back/return navigation lands somewhere other than the list the user came from.
